text:
Tess (Docs): opened PR to add a compact Optimize toolkit note: per-route vs global batching, prefix-KV behavior, and a short migration map for quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (draft)
Alex P.: can you include a tiny CLI example showing how infra teams can apply a JSON route config? they like copy-pasteable snippets.
Tess (Docs): adding Node + Python + a small bash CLI example that posts a JSON route config to the control plane. keeping it to ~6 lines each.
Priya N.: linkcheck caught a stale model tag and an old SDK import. update open-llama-13b -> open-llama-13b-v2 and replace @redwood/sdk with @redwood/inference-js for Node.
linkcheck-bot: ci/docs-linkcheck failed on head: 1 broken link and 1 model alias (docs/optkit/mini.md: line 27). Logs: https://ci.redwood/1234/linkcheck
Tess (Docs): fixed both and pushed. also rename legacy profiles to new aliases: compact-q4 and stable-q8 in the mapping YAML. adding one-line guidance: "Run your evals; use compact-q4 for cost-sensitive workloads if quality is acceptable; prefer stable-q8 for instruction-heavy flows."
Alex P.: bench numbers would help the migration note. bench-bot, any quick synthetic numbers for q4 vs q8 at batch=5?
bench-bot: lightweight synth run: compact-q4 (q4_0) @ batch=5 median token-latency 38ms, stable-q8 (q8_0) @ batch=5 median token-latency 57ms; cost delta ~ -33% for compact-q4. gist: https://bench.redwood/q4v8-synth
Tess (Docs): added the single-line tradeoff with the bench link. also included a tiny JSON route config example for infra teams: {"model":"open-llama-13b-v2","batching":{"maxTokensPerBatch":1000,"maxBatchSize":5,"timeoutMs":10},"kv_prefetch":{"enabled":true,"ttlSeconds":240}}
Priya N.: please add a one-line caveat about when not to batch: sub-100ms SLOs, stateful multi-turn agents, and latency-sensitive token-by-token generation. Also mention kv_prefetch RAM tradeoff for very large prefixes.
Tess (Docs): added both caveats and a small "When to prefer global defaults vs per-route" bullet: global defaults for org-wide consistency, per-route for heterogeneous workloads.
Alex P.: minor nit: change timeoutMs to 10 in the Node snippet to match runtime default. Also update Go import path to github.com/redwood/inference-go in the Go example.
Tess (Docs): updated timeout and Go import. ci-bot: running examples linter now.
ci-bot: ci/samples-lint found an import in examples/node that referenced @redwood/sdk.
Tess (Docs): fixed remaining import, repushed. Jordan (Docs) will do final copyedits after PRI review. tagging @Priya N. for final approve on accuracy language.
Priya N.: LGTM with one small wording tweak (use imperative present tense: "Enable KV prefetch" not "You should enable").
Tess (Docs): updated phrasing and added anchor #optkit-compact for release notes. tagging for merge once CI is green. thanks! :white_check_mark:
